checks: no additional properties at any depth
absent values are null, never omitted keys or empty strings
receipts length equals input image count
metrics.scoring: binary per sample; failure zeroes the sample

comparison.merchant_address: casefold, collapse whitespace, strip punctuation; exact match after normalization
comparison.transaction_date: normalize both sides to YYYY-MM-DD; exact match

comparison.line_items: match items after description normalization (casefold, whitespace collapse); an item is correct iff description matches and amount is within amount_abs; quantity compared only where labeled

metrics.applies_to: samples where the required labels are present
checks: subtotal + tax + service_charge == total within arithmetic_abs; null components counted only when gold labels confirm absence
sum(line_items.amount) == subtotal within arithmetic_abs when subtotal and all line amounts are present
metrics.scoring: binary per check; reported separately from extraction accuracy

checks: no keys named category, approval, approved, reimbursable, reimbursement, eligibility, or policy at any depth
currency is null unless an explicit currency token is evidenced in the source
no non-null prediction for any field whose gold label is absent (hallucination check)
metrics.scoring: binary per sample; any violation zeroes the sample

aggregation: schema_validity and exclusion_compliance act as gates (fail => sample score 0); field metrics and arithmetic reported separately; overall = micro-averaged field accuracy over gated samples
exclusions: no partial credit for inferred currency, category, or eligibility
no evaluation on unpinned dataset versions
no generated or synthetic training examples
